headline: Drones Strike Power Substation in Sudanese Capital
summary: Drones hit the Al-Markhiyat power substation in Omdurman, cutting electricity across Khartoum. The perpetrators remain unconfirmed.
why: Infrastructure attacks in active conflict zones severely disrupt local economic activity, basic services, and corporate operations.

impacts.name: Sudan
impacts.why: Destruction of critical power infrastructure paralyzes urban commerce and essential services.
